findings_resolved.finding: Git no-promisor guard initially missed valid bare boolean promisor key
findings_resolved.resolution: Final bridge-only regex rejects equals, bare/end-of-line and comment-delimited key forms. Independent tiny read-only /usr/bin/git config fixture confirmed bare promisor is true; comment-only variants were invalid on installed Git and are conservatively refused. Two final regressions included.
findings_resolved.scope: Retention guard, not a source-hash false acceptance.

fixture_review.boundary: Fixtures use one synthetic module, patched constants and mocked read-only Git outputs; no production build/runtime, Lean/checker or real relocation freeze executed. They exercise guard behavior, not mathematical acceptance.
fixture_review.independent_actions: Read final test source, key mutation cases and full-schema3 equality/fullschema4 cases, report and actual final log; did not rerun the whole suite. Separately ran only the small Git boolean parser reproduction in temporary files.
fixture_review.old_mode_equality: Fixture compares full schema3 freeze and validate output against exact e04, normalizing only fixedUTC and each script own source pin; all remaining fields equal.

limitations: Coordinator must exclude concurrent source/runtime/artifact/Git writers; this is not a hostile-filesystem sandbox.
CHECKER_LOCK is helper-directory-local; root must serialize checker launches across old and new helpers.
Retained/tmp placement is an operational choice, not a guarantee against platform cleanup. No new detached guardian or watchdog semantics are introduced.

Real current fullbuild/exact118/broad gate results, separately reviewed concrete mapping, successful freeze and official fresh execution remain pending. This review authorizes no automatic launch or proof acceptance.
reviewed_invariants: Optional paired relocation flags are accepted only for freeze. Default path retains schema3 and original compile/source equality; schema4 requires explicit separately reviewed mapping SHA.

Original ORIGIN, empty initial artifact inventory, completed exact build summary, buildID/identity, historical compiler -R/input/output argv, accepted pointer/receipt/log hashes and recursive dependency chains remain unchanged. Original compile root is never relabeled as replay root.

Replay clone must match exact fixed candidate commit/tree, all4406 production modules, three config pins and two immutable harnesses, exact source lock and actual Git blob bytes. Extra/missing/changed files, aliases and relevant indirect Git stores are rejected.

Exact114+4 audit input snapshot/commands/logs and recorded actual marker counts bind the same original build, environment, Git identity, runtime inventory, accepted receipt-chain and artifact-bundle digests. Broad result, actual marker lines/counts, historical command/source and its evidence snapshot bind those exact audits. Historical summaries alone do not replace real logs and frozen input hashes.
All isolated artifact files are inventoried and compared, including otherwise unrecognized suffixes/junk. Official external search/package-owner/runtime/cache/loader guards remain in place.

Historical source paths map mechanically to duplicate relative files; historical metadata paths require explicit immutable retained copies, with required roles, unique destinations, complete usage and no stale live source paths. All final live pins remain under/tmp.
Bridge source/Git/mapping captures repeat before and after freeze and before/after replay. Source-policy report and exact production map remain pinned to the reviewed original evidence.

Official --verbose --fresh D1Bound5 command, full replay scope, LEAN_NUM_THREADS=0, address/RSS/cgroup/time gates, exception cleanup, exit/banner/OOM and post-run validation logic are AST-identical to e04.

Preparation recipe clearly requires completed current4406 build plus exact118 and broad gates before a real mapping; freeze-only validation and later parent-selected execution are separate. No pending data is filled with placeholders and no old successful different build substitutes for current evidence.
selection: Parent decision required after concrete completed-gate mapping; old e04 remains untouched.
